# Kyoto 5-Day Trip Plan for October 12–16, 2026

A balanced, low-stress Kyoto itinerary for 2 adults with **JPY 120,000 lodging** and **JPY 60,000 food/activities** total. I’ve paced it for temple visits, quiet streets, local meals, and one easy day trip, with rainy-day backups built in.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Arrive, Gion, and Higashiyama Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in, and keep the first half-day light.
- Afternoon: Walk **Gion**, Yasaka Shrine area, and the quieter lanes around **Higashiyama**.
- Dinner: Kaiseki-style set meal or a simple tofu/udon dinner near Gion.
- Rain backup: Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art or a slow café session in downtown Kyoto.
- Pacing: **Easy**; avoid packing in too many sights on arrival day.
- Estimated cost: Lodging **JPY 24,000**; food/activities **JPY 9,000**; total **JPY 33,000**

### Day 2: Arashiyama Temples and Riverside Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Start early at **Tenryu-ji** and the bamboo grove before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Walk to **Okochi Sanso Garden** or the river area; add **Iwatayama** only if you want more walking.
- Dinner: Yudofu, soba, or a seasonal tofu set meal.
- Rain backup: **Kyoto Railway Museum** or **Arashiyama Monkey Park** skipped in favor of covered temple/museum time.
- Pacing: **Moderate**; best kept as a mostly outdoor day with an early start.
- Estimated cost: Lodging **JPY 24,000**; food/activities **JPY 12,000**; total **JPY 36,000**

### Day 3: Northern Kyoto Quiet Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early, then continue to **Ryoan-ji** for a calmer temple contrast.
- Afternoon: Explore **Ninna-ji** or the surrounding residential streets for a quieter pace.
- Dinner: Local izakaya or a small noodle shop in the city center.
- Rain backup: Kyoto National Museum or Kyoto City Zoo, depending on your preference for culture vs. indoor leisure.
- Pacing: **Moderate**; temple-heavy but not rushed.
- Estimated cost: Lodging **JPY 24,000**; food/activities **JPY 11,000**; total **JPY 35,000**

### Day 4: Day Trip to Nara
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Take an early train to **Nara Park** and **Todai-ji**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/25/DeerNaraJapan.jpg Alt=Morning: Take an early train to **Nara Park** and **Todai-ji**, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Stroll to **Kasuga Taisha** and the quieter paths in Nara Park before heading back.
- Dinner: Return to Kyoto for a relaxed local meal near your hotel.
- Rain backup: Swap the park-heavy plan for **Nara National Museum** and longer temple time.
- Pacing: **Moderate to full**; one destination-focused day, but still easy by train.
- Estimated cost: Lodging **JPY 24,000**; food/activities **JPY 14,000**; total **JPY 38,000**

### Day 5: Nishiki Market, Downtown Kyoto, and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for snacks, pickles, sweets, and souvenirs.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for snacks, pickles, sweets, and souvenirs, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Keep it flexible with **Teramachi/Shinkyogoku** shopping streets or a final temple stop if time allows.
- Dinner: Use this as your final Kyoto meal if you depart later; otherwise keep it to lunch.
- Rain backup: Department store food halls, Kyoto Station shopping, or a tea house visit.
- Pacing: **Easy**; leave buffer time for packing and transit.
- Estimated cost: Lodging **JPY 24,000**; food/activities **JPY 14,000**; total **JPY 38,000**

## Budget Fit and Trip Rhythm

| Day | Lodging | Food/Activities | Daily Total | Pace |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Day 1 | JPY 24,000 | JPY 9,000 | JPY 33,000 | Easy |
| Day 2 | JPY 24,000 | JPY 12,000 | JPY 36,000 | Moderate |
| Day 3 | JPY 24,000 | JPY 11,000 | JPY 35,000 | Moderate |
| Day 4 | JPY 24,000 | JPY 14,000 | JPY 38,000 | Moderate to full |
| Day 5 | JPY 24,000 | JPY 14,000 | JPY 38,000 | Easy |

- **Lodging total:** JPY **120,000**
- **Food/activities total:** JPY **60,000**
- **Grand total:** JPY **180,000**

## Best Way to Use the Budget

- Keep lodging around **JPY 24,000/night total for 2 adults** to stay on target.
- Spend more on **Day 4** because the Nara day trip adds transport and admission costs.
- Save money on lunches with **market food, noodle shops, and temple-area set meals**.
- For quieter pacing, aim for **1 main area per half-day** instead of stacking multiple districts.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Map Kyoto Areas](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+temples+Gion+Arashiyama+Nara)
Action: [Button: Train to Nara](https://www.jr-odekake.net/)

## Sources

- Kyoto tourism overview: https://kyoto.travel/en
- JR West travel information: https://www.westjr.co.jp/global/en/
- Nara tourism information: https://www.visitnara.jp/en/
